Help & Guide

Har app mein kya milega — ek nazar mein.

🚌 Van Register
• Students — list, fee status filter, Excel download
• Schools / Teachers — tap school name to see its students
• Routes — driver ke stops fix karein
• Fee Summary — Monthly/Yearly toggle se dekhein
• Overview — revenue trend, top vehicles, document alerts
👨‍✈️ Employee Management
• Drivers — salary, attendance, documents, PIN login
• Delay Reports / Leave Requests / School Messages — sab yahin approve karein
• Driver Policy — agreement text edit karein
🚐 Vehicle Expenses
• Fuel category select karte hi odometer/litres field khulega — mileage khud calculate hoga
• Vehicle edit karke Monthly Budget aur Service Due date set karein
• Summary tab mein cost comparison aur Excel export
💰 Loan Tracker
• Loans add karein, EMI aur interest track karein
📱 Baaki Portals
• Parent Portal — fee status, PDF receipt, absent-today button
• Driver Portal — route, live location, delay report, leave request
• Teacher / School Portal — driver contact, delay alerts
